item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Srettha preferred force as the first option in a crisis where diplomacy was available. The strongest relevant evidence comes from Myanmar-border diplomacy, humanitarian access, ASEAN engagement, and bilateral bargaining. I did not find a clear contrary case, so the record supports a de-escalatory reading rather than a mixed or force-first one.","evidence":[{"title":"ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Statement on the Escalation of Conflicts in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 18, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand joined ASEAN’s call for an immediate cessation of violence, utmost restraint, defusing tensions, and safe humanitarian access in Myanmar.
